claim: r/redditsync on Reddit: the problem with redgifs
summary: For future reference, subdomains (*.redgifs.com) still belong to the same entity as the main domain (redgifs.com). I also took a look at the certificate, and it's valid for redgifs and all subdomains, so in this case you can safely rule out malicious behavior. As for how to get rid of it, uh...
